notes: Vite development runtime; JS/HTML/CSS transport is not production build budget. Visual asset budget deduplicates ResourceTiming encodedBodySize per URL. Screenshot/menu auxiliary requests are excluded.

Parent authorized only print dark-text tokens during the collection window. Screen CSS was held stable; a changed CSS hash must be read with this print-only exception. The interrupted attempt was repeated in the same four contexts to finish menu evidence after a transient missing menu during HMR.

All four current routes returned 200; no 404, failed requests, V3 assets, external requests or page errors were observed. Mobile menus were visually inspected open and closed; their bounds stay near x20..370 at width390.

fidelityFindings.detail: The global .eyebrow color remains var(--atv-text-accent)=#8c6330 on the dark Home. The approved Home selector changes type and spacing without resetting this color; in the approved standalone reference it inherits ivory. Screenshot shows the dark accent on the hero and free section.
